---
title: "Computing setup"
subtitle: "Complete before the first meeting if possible"
---

## Checklist

- [ ] Install a current version of [R](https://cran.r-project.org).
- [ ] Install [RStudio Desktop](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/).
- [ ] Install [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads).
- [ ] Create a [GitHub](https://github.com) account.
- [ ] Send your GitHub username to the instructor privately.
- [ ] Create a normal local course folder outside Dropbox, iCloud Drive,
      OneDrive, and network storage.
- [ ] Accept your private A1 repository invitation when it arrives.

You do **not** need to install LaTeX. RStudio includes Quarto, and assignments
will normally render to HTML. When PDF output is required, Quarto will use
Typst.

::: {.callout-tip title="Ask early"}
Bring installation or authentication problems to the first seminar or office
hours. Include the exact error text and what you were trying to do; never send
a password, personal access token, or other secret.
:::
